title: Phone Stand — Illustrated Design Process
description: Synthetic example; no real designer recording or CAD construction history.

steps.title: Establish the footprint
steps.reasoning: I choose a wide base first so I can evaluate stability before fixing the viewing angle.

captions.text: First, I define a broad footprint for stability.
Now I extrude it, keeping the plate relatively thin.
This dimension is a design choice, not a requirement.

steps.title: Choose a viewing angle
steps.reasoning: The back panel is angled for viewing, but I can change its inclination if the phone or context changes.

captions.text: I introduce a back panel to carry the phone.
I tilt it instead of assuming the first angle is final.
The angle depends on how the stand will be used.

steps.title: Prevent the phone from sliding
steps.reasoning: I add a shallow lip to prevent slipping while leaving room to reach the bottom of the device.

captions.text: A small lip holds the device near the lower edge.
I extrude only enough to resist sliding.
The phone size might call for a different lip.
